blocks.text: BAYAMBANG, Pangasinan – Onsite classes in this central Pangasinan town are suspended on Friday, Oct. 9, to allow teachers to attend a municipal-wide celebration of World Teachers’ Day. Schools will shift to asynchronous learning and modular distance learning to ensure that students continue their studies during the suspension. Bayambang Mayor Mary Clare Phyllis Judith Jose Quaimbao signed Executive Order No. 164-2026 on Thursday, Oct. 8, citing the need to recognize teachers’ dedication, sacrifices and service to learners.
